opening.argument: The offer is framed around concrete financial returns: viewers are told they can sell tokens for “momentary profit” or hold them and “receive dividends.” The Polybius page reinforces those same choices, displaying resale after the ICO for potential profit or retention for dividends. A sale bonus is also shown, with percentages organized by day or week, alongside the speaker’s account of having bought tokens. Taken together, the material promotes token purchase through promised routes to profit and dividends, placing it squarely in the category of token purchase, appreciation or dividends. The possibility wording does not remove that central pitch: buying and holding the tokens are presented as ways to pursue financial returns.

citations.quote: you can sell on the market to get momentary profit, and you just save the tokens and receive dividends
